learner_starting_state: Can distinguish text and visual workloads but may confuse general description with schema-driven extraction.
learner_ending_state: Can identify extraction from documents/forms, images, audio, and video and protect structured output with explicit schemas, null preservation, and evidence-aware review.
mastery_gate: Score 12 of 12 on primary and fresh-transfer forms across four modalities plus schema and missing-value safeguards, then explain one extraction choice without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: AI-901 scope and current Content Understanding analyzer concepts trace to official Microsoft sources; scenarios, reasons, and gates are course-authored.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify analyzer schema, supported types/formats/languages, SDK/REST operations, API version, limits, regions, pricing, and preview/deprecation status before live use.

notes: Offline conceptual package; later L-05-07 provides the implementation-oriented multimodal extraction lab.
